source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.7.1, data build 972, released 2026-10-02

data.summary:
This rule grants two auras:

- Your **SCINTILLATING LEGIONS** units have **Daemonic Illusions (Aura)**: friendly **THOUSAND SONS PSYKER** units visible to and within 6" of such a unit get a 4+ invulnerable save versus ranged attacks.
- Your **THOUSAND SONS** units have **Mortal Sorcery (Aura)**: friendly **SCINTILLATING LEGIONS PSYKER** units visible to and within 6" of such a unit have [Cabal of Sorcerers](vsdata:ability/thousand-sons.cabal-of-sorcerers).
